verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI ships an official MCP server (documented in self-hosting docs) enabling direct connection to AI tools like Claude Code and Cursor, corroborated by community discussion of MCP setups for Cursor/Claude/n8n. However, evidence is thin — mostly single-line feature mentions and no detailed API/tool schema, and community notes new developers 'struggle' with production MCP configurations. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party MCP server documentation (tool list, auth, examples) and hands-on confirmation of smooth setup.
